meta.name: design-is
meta.description: Audit a design against Dieter Rams' ten "Good design is..." principles, then hand off a /make-plan prompt for one of three outcomes — new design, refine design, or redesign. Use when the user says "audit this design", "design review", "check this UI against Rams", "is this UI good", "critique this design", "design audit", or asks for a critique that should lead to a plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对照迪特·拉姆斯十大原则审核设计并生成改进方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要依据经典设计原则来评估和优化界面设计。
copy.tagline_en: Audit designs against Dieter Rams' ten principles and generate improvement plans
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to evaluate and improve interface designs based on classic design principles.

howto.what: Claude 会对照 Dieter Rams 的十条「好设计」原则逐条审查你的设计,每条打 0–3 分并附证据,判出新设计/改进/重做三种结论,最后给出一份 /make-plan 提示词,产物写进 DESIGN-IS-日期/ 文件夹。
howto.when: 当你提到 “audit this design”、“design review”、“check this UI against Rams” 等说法,或要求对设计做一次能落到计划的批评时触发。

say.text: 审一下这个设计,对照 Rams 十条原则打分
say.note: 逐条打分并给出新设计/改进/重做结论。

say.text: 帮我做一次设计评审,结论要能落到一份 /make-plan 计划
say.note: 最后输出可直接粘贴的 /make-plan 提示词。

say.text: 这个 UI 好不好?按 Rams 原则给我批评和分数
say.note: 十条原则各附证据引用。

howto.what_en: Claude audits your design against Dieter Rams' ten "Good design is..." principles, scores each 0–3 with cited evidence, picks a verdict (NEW / REFINE / REDESIGN), and writes a /make-plan handoff prompt into a DESIGN-IS-<date>/ folder.
howto.when_en: When you say "audit this design", "design review", "check this UI against Rams", or otherwise ask for a critique that should lead to a plan.

say_en.text: Audit this design against Rams' ten principles
say_en.note: Scores each principle 0–3 and returns a verdict.

say_en.text: Do a design review and hand off a /make-plan prompt
Is this UI good? Critique it with scores
say_en.note: Ten scored principles plus evidence citations.
